parameters.note: McKinney Creek is a tributary of Lake Tahoe (headwaters at Lily Lake, through McKinney Lake, into the lake at Chambers Landing / McKinney Bay, west shore, Placer Co.). It is not listed by its own name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), but it falls under the Lake Tahoe tributaries entry §7.50(b)(152)(A) ('Tahoe Lake tributaries upstream to the first lake'), NOT the general last-Sat-April–Nov-15 trout stream season. The special regulation covers the creek from the Lake Tahoe mouth upstream to the first lake (McKinney Lake); this dataset's point is on that lower reach. Per §7.50(a)(1), the reach is closed to all fishing except during the shown open season — so it is closed Oct. 1 through the Friday preceding the Saturday before Memorial Day. Date_spec encodes 'Saturday preceding Memorial Day' as the last Monday of May (Memorial Day) minus 2 days, since the resolver has no anchor_holiday implementation.

candidates.summary: Open catch-and-release only, Saturday before Memorial Day through Sept. 30; closed to all fishing the rest of the year (Lake Tahoe tributary special regulation, from the mouth up to McKinney Lake).
